series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: Please note that the INDC was submitted only in French. WRI did its best to translate the INDC language. If any errors are identified, please contact us at ClimateWatch@WRI.org . Gabon commits to reduce GHG emissions by at least 50 percent from baseline scenario emissions in 2025. The commitment could be extended to 2030 and 2050 based on additional studies that will be carried out by COP21. The commitment is to be achieved excluding carbon stocks from forests from the target. Gabon also submitted annexes describing land-use change, flaring from the oil industry, energy, other GHG emissions such as waste, adaptation, and financing.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: At least 50% reduction in GHG emissions by 2025 compared to the baseline scenario emissions
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

evidence.sentence: Période d'engagement Couverture : 2025-2035, alignée sur la Vision Climatique à Long-Terme du Gabon (VLT, 2024) Niveau de réduction La CDN3 établit des trajectoires chiffrées : sans FAT, réduction de -20 % (WEM) et -30 % (WAM) en 2030 par rapport au BAU, puis -23 % (WEM) et -40 % (WAM) en 2035.
Le scénario avec mesures existantes (WEM) permettrait de réduire les émissions de plus de 20 % par rapport au BAU d'ici 2030, et de plus de 23 % d'ici 2035.

DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-12-24. 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 27.4 MtCO₂e, DS-02 17.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 2 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 42.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: At least 50% reduction in GHG emissions by 2025 compared to the baseline scenario emissions It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.56°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
